title: College students are increasingly pushing back against campus AI mandates, demanding opt-outs from AI-required assignments and an end to enterprise licenses (Dana Goldstein/New York Times)
summary: Dana Goldstein / New York Times: College students are increasingly pushing back against campus AI mandates, demanding opt-outs from AI-required assignments and an end to enterprise licenses — Some students are refusing to use A.I., and others are starting petitions to limit it across entire campuses. Colleges have taken notice.
